Submitted (`ok:true`), status unchanged at **deviation**, single level: **fallback**.

What the repaired proposal does:

- **Op 1 (in-sentence replace):** strikes the no-hire words (", hire, or employ"), the 24-month tail and the "regardless of how the employee applies" sweep-up, and ties the restriction to "12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services".
- **Op 2 (one concise adjoining sentence):** supplies the mutual limb ("Neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of that involvement"), expressly cuts the retained sentence back to that same scope and period — so Customer bears no broader or duplicated covenant — and adds only the two required carve-outs (general advertisements not specifically targeted at the other party's employees; unsolicited approaches).

On the verifier's suggested single-sentence full replacement: I tested it and the closest variants (0.686, 0.724, 0.769, 0.949) — every in-sentence conversion to "Neither party / Each party" wording breaches the official 0.600 changed-character gate, so the mutual and direct-involvement limits are delivered by the adjoining sentence, which also expressly limits the retained words. All six fallback elements are mapped once; no preferred-only content and no customary extras were added.
